CyberSuite updates

I have been busy. Here is everything I have added and improved over the last six weeks, so you can see what is now sitting behind your page and ask me to switch on anything that takes your fancy.

Six weeksChristmas readyMore on the way
New

Christmas and December content

The festive season is the busiest of the year for clinics, so I built plenty to go at.

  • 20 Christmas carousels on every client pageA whole month of festive posts, each with a caption written as three friendly paragraphs, ready to schedule.
  • Soft and affable Christmas postsNew feel-good post types for people who would rather be warm than salesy at this time of year.
  • Christmas shoot in the AI Photo StudioRealistic festive portraits made from a selfie, with new looks including timeless black, white and silver, and kitsch leopard print with hot pink.
  • The December BundleTwenty Christmas posts plus ten Christmas photos in your own colours, so the whole month of socials is covered.
New

Gift vouchers

Vouchers are the quiet money maker of December, so they now have their own tool.

  • Voucher posts in your coloursStatic voucher posts with a satin bow, a floating text box and an optional photo faded behind the words.
  • 30 ready written hooks in five groupsFor the gift buyers, the family group chat and the last minute shoppers, plus a new set for offering a percentage extra free.
  • Voucher stories as a three story sequenceThe hook, the offer and the reply word, scheduled one after another.
  • Rising text reelsYour voucher or Christmas post turns into a short reel where the text box floats up the screen.
Improved

A better look

Your posts now look more like you and less like everyone else's.

  • BowsChoose a bow across, down, diagonal or in the corner, drag it wherever you like and resize it on each post.
  • Floating text boxIt now hugs the words like a text box in Canva, with an outline in any colour or metallic you choose.
  • Your colours, asked onceThe first time your page opens I ask five quick colour questions, then remember your answers.
  • More post stylesFaded page, gradient, strip, lower text box and floating box, with every style mixed through a batch of 40.
  • Quote boardsA new set of single image quote posts on a plain colour or metallic background.
  • SparkleA sparkly finish for your Christmas posts, with a colour picker.
  • Flip reelOne magazine style flip video made from all the slides of a carousel.
  • Cleaner postsI removed the swipe arrows and the clinic name along the bottom, and black bars are trimmed off photos automatically. There is also a closing slide with your clinic photo and white words over the top.
Improved

Photos

  • Choose your reference photoThe AI Photo Studio now lets me pick from your approved photos, and I can delete the ones that are not quite right.
  • Your own room in every shotAdd a photo of your clinic room and the Injector Collection places every image in that same room.
Improved

Planning and posting

  • Client BankPark finished posts with no date, then schedule them in bulk. There are new Tuesday and Thursday day buttons.
  • Pick only what you wantTick the posts or treatments you like and I make just those, which saves everyone sorting through the lot.
  • Your scheduler, one click awayEvery client page now has a schedule icon straight to your scheduler and Client Bank.
  • Your own private portalCollect your finished posts from a private page of your own, and see the posts waiting in your bank.
